name: Period for Compliance
title: Period for Compliance
text: 6. You are called upon to comply within {{compliance_period_days}} days of receipt of this notice.

legal_basis.note: No suit against the Government or a public officer until the expiration of two months next after notice in writing
Time granted for performance is at the promisee's election

source: Civil Procedure Code, 1908; Indian Contract Act, 1872
statutory_reference: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 - S.80(1); Indian Contract Act, 1872 - S.63
authoring_note: There is no general statutory period for a private demand, and fifteen days is the ordinary practice. Two situations change that. Where the addressee is the Government or a public officer sued for an official act, Section 80(1) bars the suit for two months and the period here must be at least that. Where the contract itself prescribes a cure period, that period governs and a shorter one in the notice is a breach by the sender. The advocate should check the contract before settling this figure.
